pay.test_mode.defaultMessage: テストモードです (課金されません)。
pay.test_mode.description: Notice at the top of the PAY.JP checkout and card pages while the server uses PAY.JP's test keys: no card is charged.

pay.fake_notice.defaultMessage: テスト用ビルドの、決済サービスの代わりの画面です。お金は動きません。
pay.fake_notice.description: Notice at the top of the checkout and portal pages of the fake payment provider, which only test builds have (ADR-0015 §6).

pay.back.description: Link from a payment page back to the screen of this server the user came from.

pay.card.email.description: Label of the email address field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages, which the card's 3-D Secure needs.

pay.card.name.description: Label of the card holder's name field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

pay.card.name_hint.defaultMessage: カードに記載のとおり、半角の英字で入力してください。
pay.card.name_hint.description: Hint above the card holder's name field of the card form on the PAY.JP checkout and card pages.

pay.card.label.description: Label of PAY.JP's card element (number, expiry, security code, in PAY.JP's own frame) on the checkout and card pages.

pay.card.note.defaultMessage: カードの情報は PAY.JP のフォームに入力され、このサーバーには届きません。
pay.card.note.description: Note under PAY.JP's card element on the checkout and card pages.

pay.card.failed.defaultMessage: カードを確かめられませんでした。料金は請求されていません。メールアドレス・カードの名義・カードの情報を見直して、もう一度試してください。
pay.card.failed.description: Alert of the card form when PAY.JP could not take the card and gave no reason of its own.

pay.card.unavailable.defaultMessage: カードの入力欄を読み込めませんでした。ページを読み込み直すか、しばらくしてからもう一度試してください。
pay.card.unavailable.description: Alert of the card form when PAY.JP's script (payjp.js) could not be loaded, so no card can be entered.

pay.checkout.submit.description: Button of the PAY.JP checkout page that verifies the card (3-D Secure) and starts the subscription.

pay.fake.pay.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that records the payment as paid.

pay.fake.fail.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that makes the payment fail, to test the failure.

pay.fake.cancel.description: Button of the fake provider's checkout page that goes back without paying.

pay.fake.portal.defaultMessage: テスト用ビルドには、管理する支払い方法や請求書はありません。
pay.fake.portal.description: Text of the fake provider's portal page.

pay.portal.card.description: Heading of the card in use on the PAY.JP card page (the customer portal).

pay.portal.no_card.defaultMessage: カードは登録されていません。
pay.portal.no_card.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without a card.

pay.portal.change_card.description: Heading and button of the card change form on the PAY.JP card page.

pay.portal.history.description: Heading of the recent payments on the PAY.JP card page.

pay.portal.history_empty.defaultMessage: 支払いはまだありません。
pay.portal.history_empty.description: Text of the PAY.JP card page without payments.

pay.portal.paused.defaultMessage: 直近の支払いに失敗したため、加入が一時停止されています。カードを変更すると支払いが行われ、加入が再開します。
pay.portal.paused.description: Alert of the PAY.JP card page while a subscription is paused after a failed payment.

pay.portal.payment.description: A payment in the recent payments of the PAY.JP card page. {date} is its date (YYYY-MM-DD) and {amount} its amount, already formatted.

pay.portal.payment_refunded.description: A payment in the recent payments of the PAY.JP card page that was refunded in part or in full. {date} is its date (YYYY-MM-DD), {amount} its amount and {refunded} what was refunded, both already formatted.
